registryBasis: The state budgetary institution of Volgograd Oblast Center for State Cadastral Valuation publishes the official public-cadastral-map notice and directs users to the federal NSDP map. This supports a public cadastral-map route applicable to Volgograd, but no feature schema, safe geometry+ID allowlist, or parcel at the WUP point was verified.

portals.observation: Official GBU VO Center for State Cadastral Valuation notice (2025-02-06) states the public cadastral map moved to federal NSDP and is publicly accessible without registration or fee.
